# sspi_platform (Resource)

Manages a Security Service Platform (SSP) or Avi Operations instance deployment.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The vSphere cluster moref ID.
- `content_datastore_id` (String) The vSphere content datastore moref ID.
- `datacenter_id` (String) The vSphere datacenter moref ID.
- `display_name` (String) The instance name for the platform. Not editable after creation.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) The DNS servers for the cluster.
- `domain` (String) The search domain for the platform (skipped by DNS resolution).
- `form_factor` (String) The compute form factor of the platform. One of `COMPACT`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`, `EXTRA_LARGE`.
- `ingress_fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the platform, associated with the ingress controller's external IP.
- `kafka_fqdn` (String) The FQDN of Kafka running in the platform, associated with the `kafka-external` service IP.
- `network_id` (String) The virtual switch moref ID for platform cluster nodes.
- `node_ip_pool` (List of String) Node IP pool ranges, each formatted as `start-end` (e.g. `172.16.111.50-172.16.111.60`).
- `ntp_server` (String) The NTP server for the cluster.
- `platform_default_gateway` (String) The default gateway used by the platform nodes.
- `platform_subnet` (String) The subnet where the cluster will run, in CIDR notation (e.g. `192.168.1.1/24`).
- `portgroup_id` (String) The portgroup moref ID used for platform cluster nodes.
- `provider_id` (String) The ID of the vSphere provider (`ssp_vsphere_provider`) to deploy the platform to.
- `service_ip_pool` (List of String) Service IP pool ranges, each formatted as `start-end` (e.g. `172.16.111.70-172.16.111.80`).
- `ssp_bundle_id` (String) The ID of the uploaded software bundle (`ssp_bundle_local`) to deploy.

### Optional

- `addon_ids` (List of String) The add-ons to attach to the platform.
- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive) The admin user password for the platform. If unset, the platform default is used.
- `audit_password` (String, Sensitive) The audit user password for the platform. If unset, the platform default is used.
- `cluster_name` (String) The vSphere cluster name.
- `controller_count` (Number) The number of controller nodes. Valid range depends on `form_factor`/`ssp_type`.
- `datacenter_name` (String) The vSphere datacenter name.
- `datastore` (String) The vSphere content datastore name.
- `enable_resource_reservation` (Boolean) Whether CPU and memory resources for the instance should be reserved at the resource pool level.
- `network` (String) The name of the virtual switch for platform cluster nodes.
- `portgroup_name` (String) The portgroup name used for platform cluster nodes.
- `preserve_addons` (Boolean) Whether to retain compatible add-ons across instance upgrades.
- `ssp_bundle_version` (String) The version of the software bundle to deploy.
- `ssp_type` (String) The type of SSP deployment. One of `ATP`, `LICENSING`, `AVI_OPERATIONS`. Defaults to `ATP`.
- `storage_policy_id` (String) The vSphere storage policy ID.
- `storage_policy_name` (String) The vSphere storage policy name.
- `vm_folder_name` (String) The vSphere VM folder to place platform VMs into.
- `vm_template` (String) The VM template used to provision platform nodes.
- `worker_count` (Number) The number of worker nodes. Valid range depends on `form_factor`/`ssp_type`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the SSP platform instance.
- `status` (String) The current deployment status.
